displayPattern: Amber status LED on a Bryant 926TB: short flashes, then long flashes. Code 13 is 1 short flash and 3 long flashes
meaning: Limit circuit lockout. The limit or flame rollout switch was open longer than 3 minutes, or 10 successive limit trips occurred during high heat. The control auto-resets after 3 hours. The manual says to see status code 33.
causes: Limit switch open longer than 3 minutes
Flame rollout switch open longer than 3 minutes
10 successive limit trips during high heat
diySteps: Count 1 short flash and 3 long flashes before you cut power. The 3-hour auto-reset is not a repair
If a rollout switch has opened, leave the furnace off. Do not reset it and walk away
Technician: use status code 33, which this lockout points to, to find which switch opened
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if 13 is stored. This Bryant page only states what code 13 itself says. It does not copy another brand's cause list onto code 33.
